actor: Investment fair-value measurement lead, Amazon corporate accounting
job: Re-measuring the Anthropic equity holding every quarter under unobservable inputs, and isolating the period fair-value change as a single discrete component.
outcome: A separately identified pre-tax fair-value change on the Anthropic investment, clean enough to be excluded from net income and reconciled line by line.
motivation: An item cannot be excluded from a bottom line unless the measurement that produced it is separable, repeatable and defensible every quarter.

task.who: Investment accounting and valuation teams inside Amazon corporate accounting
task.what: Re-measure the Anthropic holding and isolate the period fair-value change
task.where: Amazon's quarterly close and non-marketable equity securities valuation file
task.why: An excluded item must first be separately measurable
task.how: Level 3 fair-value model built on unobservable private-round inputs

actor: Technical accounting policy lead, Amazon external reporting
job: Drafting the policy memo that defines net income and diluted earnings per share excluding the Anthropic fair-value change as a non-GAAP measure.
outcome: An approved measure definition, with its reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP figure, ready to drop into a quarterly results release.
motivation: Amazon reconciles free cash flow variants and constant-currency growth already; the mechanism exists and has simply never been pointed at earnings.

task.who: Technical accounting and financial reporting policy group
task.what: Define an excluded-mark net income and per-share non-GAAP measure
task.where: Accounting policy memo circulated to Amazon's disclosure committee
task.why: A measure needs a written definition before it prints
task.how: Existing free cash flow reconciliation template, extended to earnings

actor: Securities reporting counsel, Amazon disclosure and SEC reporting group
job: Clearing the proposed excluded-mark earnings measure against Regulation G and Item 10(e), including the equal-or-greater prominence ordering inside the release.
outcome: A cleared presentation in which the GAAP net income and per-share figures lead and the excluded-mark measure follows, reconciled in the same exhibit.
motivation: A non-GAAP earnings measure that fails the prominence and reconciliation rules invites a staff comment letter and gets pulled back out.

task.who: Securities counsel and SEC reporting staff in Amazon's legal department
task.what: Clear the excluded-mark measure against Regulation G prominence rules
task.where: Disclosure committee review of the Form 8-K earnings exhibit
task.why: A non-compliant presentation gets withdrawn, not repeated
task.how: Regulation G and Item 10(e) compliance checklist

actor: Income tax accounting lead, Amazon tax reporting
job: Computing the deferred tax effect of the Anthropic fair-value change so the excluded item can be removed from net income on an after-tax basis.
outcome: A tax-effected exclusion amount that turns the pre-tax mark into the after-tax figure a net income or per-share measure can actually subtract.
motivation: A pre-tax number cannot be subtracted from an after-tax bottom line; without the tax effect there is no excluded-basis figure.

task.who: Income tax provision and deferred tax teams in Amazon tax reporting
task.what: Tax-effect the Anthropic fair-value change for the excluded-basis figure
task.where: Full-year 2026 income tax provision and year-end close
task.why: Only an after-tax amount can leave net income
task.how: Deferred tax computation on the unrealised equity mark

job: Running the results cycle in which management is asked which profit number to use, and deciding what the release itself presents.
outcome: A results release carrying an excluded-mark net income or per-share figure rather than leaving every reader to carry out the subtraction independently.
motivation: Guidance is net sales and operating income only, so the reported bottom line is the one number management does not currently frame.

task.who: Investor relations and earnings communications team
task.what: Place an excluded-mark earnings figure in the results release
task.where: Quarterly results release and earnings call preparation
task.why: The guided measure and the reported measure must agree
task.how: Earnings release drafting cycle with the chief financial officer

actor: Capital formation lead, Anthropic corporate finance
job: Running the priced financing rounds whose valuations reset the primary input behind Amazon's quarterly fair-value mark on its Anthropic holding.
outcome: A valuation that keeps moving, so the mark stays large enough to dominate a bottom line and large enough to reverse into one.
motivation: Anthropic raises to fund compute; the round price is a by-product it needs, and Amazon's quarterly measurement has to follow it.

task.who: Corporate finance and investor syndicate team at Anthropic
task.what: Close a priced round that resets the holding's carrying valuation
task.where: Anthropic's private financing process with existing and new investors
task.why: A flat valuation stops producing headline-sized marks
task.how: Priced preferred round with a stated post-money valuation

actor: Segment reporting and planning lead, Amazon Web Services finance
job: Producing the AWS segment operating income and run-rate disclosures that carry the return argument for roughly $220 billion of 2026 capital expenditure.
outcome: An operating return case stated in figures the Anthropic mark cannot touch, making an excluded-mark bottom line the natural next disclosure.
motivation: Trailing free cash flow has turned to an outflow, so the case for the spend has to be made on segment results.

task.who: AWS segment finance and financial planning and analysis teams
task.what: Report AWS segment operating income against AI capital expenditure
task.where: Segment reporting inside the quarterly results release and Form 10-Q
task.why: The spending case cannot rest on a paper mark
task.how: Segment operating income and annualised run-rate disclosure

actor: External reporting manager, Amazon financial reporting
job: Building the reconciliation exhibit that bridges GAAP net income and diluted earnings per share to the excluded-mark measure, quarter by quarter.
outcome: A reconciliation table printed inside Amazon's own results release, alongside the GAAP figures and covering the comparative prior-year period.
motivation: Naming the pre-tax mark in a sentence is the Rivian form; a reconciled excluded-basis figure is a different disclosure entirely.

task.who: External reporting and SEC filings production team
task.what: Build the GAAP-to-excluded-mark reconciliation table for the earnings exhibit
task.where: Earnings release exhibit filed on Form 8-K
task.why: The excluded-basis number itself has to appear, not be inferred
task.how: Reconciliation table modelled on the existing free cash flow exhibit
